lemmas.primary_translation: to exceed the limit of what is permissible / to go too far

definitions.translation: to exceed the limit of what is permissible

examples.no: det er greit å være uenig, men personangrep er å gå over streken
examples.en: It is fine to disagree, but personal attacks are going too far.

examples.no: mest kommer han med godlynte artigheter, men innimellom går han også over streken
examples.en: Mostly he comes out with good-natured witticisms, but now and then he goes too far as well.
